data.name: Actanol Energie
data.description: ACTANOL Energie GmbH (Kempten, Germany) was founded in 2024 as a dedicated renewable-energy arm of the ACTANOL Group to plan, finance and operate pyrolysis plants using Carbo-FORCE technology. The company produces heat, electricity, biochar and CO2 removal certificates from biomass pyrolysis, and is a member of the German Biochar association.
